Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1890

Report for the Year ending 31st December 1890 and Budget for the Year 1891
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1891

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the accounts and the budget (each sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose and letters are not. The Fire Record (a dated list of fires) is given as a chronology. The volume prints no table of contents (only an alphabetical index), so the book's contents list here is made of bracketed section headings in the order of the volume. The scan is of lower resolution than later volumes, and it lacks eight printed pages of the financial statement (pp. 258–259, 262–263, 266–267 and 270–271): the item lines that run on from those pages are given as separate tables noting the gap, and the running totals across them cannot be checked. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (12 cells). The budget has its own page numbers, as printed.
